# Issue #2394 Thread Consolidation

The lead requested consolidation and removal of deprecated comments. This documentation-only snapshot preserves the complete original issue body and all 89 comments captured on 2026-09-29 before any edits/deletions. The live issue remains the operational record; this archive is not a new gate or merge dependency.

- `snapshot.json`: captured issue fields and original comment text, authors, IDs, timestamps and URLs; explicit per-comment disposition.
- `thread.md`: readable verbatim bodies; use `#comment-<id>` anchors to recover a removed comment.
- Fifteen ruling, limitation and current-evidence permalinks remain live. Seventy-four superseded proposals, implementation checkpoints and redundant reports are removed only after this archive is pushed and verified.
- Retained historical comments receive a status banner and collapsed original text. The final qualification receipt's historical "79/79 jobs passed" wording is corrected visibly to 78 successful jobs plus one intentional skip.
- No acceptance limit, runtime contract, issue assignment, merge policy or implementation scope changes through this consolidation.
- The historical unexecuted advisory-hash-collision concern and SQLite prepared-statement limitation remain explicitly preserved; neither is silently treated as resolved.
